_comment: Load-bearing .modern-ui-v3 scoped rules whose var() fallback equals the token value but that CANNOT be de-stacked (or are pending a batch). check-de-stack flags any fallback==token consumer NOT covered here. Prefix match on the normalized selector.

patterns..modern-ui-v3 .save-btn: themes.css [data-theme^='dark-'] .save-btn recolors bg/color/border per-accent at (0,2,0) (equal specificity, !important border-color) — the base (0,1,0) would lose
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .cancel-btn: base consumes --sm-btn-radius (8px) while the scoped rule keeps 10px via --sm-cancel-radius — the rule is load-bearing for the radius, not redundant
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .sync-btn: themes.css [data-theme^='dark-'] .sync-btn forces the per-accent gradient at (0,2,0) > base (0,1,0)
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .add-btn: themes.css [data-theme^='dark-'] .add-btn forces the per-accent look at (0,2,0) > base (0,1,0)
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .reset-shortcuts-btn: settings secondary batch — shares the --set-btn-* consumer with sync/add (themes.css dark-* family)
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .close-btn: settings secondary batch — light variant is literal (light --set-btn-* differs); shares the --set-btn-* consumer
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .import-btn: themes.css [data-theme^='dark-'] .import-btn:hover recolors the hover per-accent; cross-file shared classes (confirm/swap/order) have no base
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .settings-content select: dark :focus/option rules beat themes.css [data-theme^='dark-'] .settings-content select:focus/option (0,3,1); light rules carry light values as fallbacks (not in the light token block)
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .form-group input:focus: themes.css [data-theme^='dark-'] .form-group input:focus (0,3,1) beats the base (0,2,1) — would force the per-accent focus ring
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .category-manager: cm/chm modal chrome family — light values live in the light token block; ModernThemeBase light covers the manager-header close buttons
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .failover-group-list-conte: cm/chm scrollbar + pane family — same light-block/ModernThemeBase reasoning as category-manager
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .video-glass-border: v3-only video player glass surface (no v1/v2 base) — thin consumer, token is source of truth
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .guide-: guide family — themes.css has per-theme guide overrides (dark-slate etc.); light values live in the light token block
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .tvcp-: TV Calendar topbar — same guide-family reasoning
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .category-strip: category strip glass chrome — themes.css per-theme category overrides
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .sidebar-section-header: sidebar section header divider — themes.css per-theme sidebar overrides
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .vod-: VOD family — themes.css [data-theme^='dark-']/.glass-* targets .vod-home/.vod-browse backgrounds; light values in light token block
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .movie-detail: VOD detail family — same VOD reasoning
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .series-detail: VOD series/season/episode family — same VOD reasoning
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .media-card: themes.css [data-theme^='dark-']/.glass-* targets .media-card backgrounds at higher specificity than the base
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .hero__: VOD hero overlays — same VOD reasoning
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .stremio-row-: stremio row nav/see-all — same VOD reasoning
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .game-detail-scoring-play: NOT de-stackable: the GameDetail.css base uses a 3px accent border-left (home/away stripe) while v3 deliberately uses a uniform 1px border — one token cannot render both looks (the rest of the game-detail/ufc family WAS de-stacked into the base)
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .subtitle-: subtitle modal family — themes.css [data-theme*='glass-'] styles .track-modal; light values in light token block
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .track-: track modal family — themes.css [data-theme*='glass-'] .track-modal targets it
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .nuvio-: nuvio topbar chrome only (shared stremio/nuvio group consuming --stremio-topbar-* tokens, themes.css glass-gated) — the filter/card family was de-stacked into NuvioPage.css
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .source-form input: source form inputs — same cascade reasoning as form-group input:focus (themes.css dark-* form focus)
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .action-divider: context-menu action divider — folded thin consumer (context-menu family)
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .cgm-rename-input: custom-group rename input — cm/chm family reasoning
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .wc-hub-container: world-cup hub — folded thin consumer; light values in light token block
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .nuvio-login-: nuvio login card — folded thin consumer; light values in light token block
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .program-block: program-block family — themes.css per-theme program overrides; light values in light token block
patterns..modern-ui-v3 .source-type: source type chips — themes.css [data-theme^='dark-'] .source-type uses !important per-accent colors
patterns.html.modern-ui-v3[data-theme=\"light\"]: light-scoped rules: light values live in the light token block (fallbacks match) and must beat the light sheet/base in light; dark tokens would otherwise resolve
patterns.html.modern-ui-v3[data-theme]: theme-gated guide/EPG rules: themes.css per-theme guide overrides (dark-slate etc.) and the light block both require the scoped specificity
